🚀 job-ops | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To significantly increase the efficiency and effectiveness of a job search by automating repetitive tasks and providing intelligent insights, all within a self-hosted environment.
✨ Key Features: • Aggregates job searches from 10+ job boards • AI-powered job scoring against user profile • Automated CV tailoring for each job description • Local PDF CV export or integration with Reactive Resume
📖 Summary: JobOps is a self-hosted DevOps-inspired job hunting pipeline that automates the job search process. It aggregates job listings from multiple boards, scores applications based on user profiles, tailors CVs, and tracks application statuses by connecting to Gmail.
